properties.notes: Former offices that are to provide 30 flats through a combination of conversion, extension and new-build (13/02074/FUL). Work has commenced, so the planning permission has been implemented and will not lapse, but no start has been made on residential aspect to date. Until housebuilding commences, the site will remain on the BF Register. Yield and density indicated recognises redevelopment to provide apartments.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
